title: Welcome to the Amazon
welcome_lead: Step into the green giant! The Amazon is Earth's largest tropical rainforest. Discover its climate and incredible scale.

final_note: Brilliant! You now know the basics of the Amazon rainforest.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Amazon covers about 5.5 million km² across 9 countries, mostly Brazil. It's bigger than the EU!
Temperatures stay near 28°C all year. Rainfall reaches around 2,000mm per year — that's ten times more than London!
Near the Equator, the Sun heats moist air which rises, cools and forms huge clouds. Rain falls almost daily — usually in afternoon storms.
